notes.model: The 3DModelsCC0 Makarov (CC0; content/guns.json, its magazine put back in the grip), replacing the flat-colour kit pistol, now the fallback.
notes.design: Benchmark A (service pistol): instant handling, moderate damage and velocity, low recoil, true first shot, fast reload.
notes.fireMode: One shot per click; holding the trigger doesn't keep firing (the Machine Pistol is the automatic one).
